pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SUICIDE, HUH...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE GUY LYING FACE-DOWN IS HIS BODYGUARD.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THIS IS THE THIRD CASE THIS YEAR IN OUR JURISDICTION ALONE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: 'COURSE THEIR HANDS WERE PRETTY BLOODY TO BEGIN WITH.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: OTHER PEOPLE'S LIVES DIDN'T MEAN A THING TO THEM... ...BUT THEIR OWN, THEY HAD A PRETTY HIGH OPINION OF HARDLY THE SUICIDAL TYPE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHEN WAS THE FIRST ONE?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: I THINK CHARLIE HAS THE LIST...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: RIGHT HERE, SIR.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THE FIRST WAS ON JANUARY THE FIFTH, RICHARD BACH, AGED 45. LIVED ON EAST 152ND.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: SUSPICION OF MOB TIES. SHOT HIMSELF IN THE RIGHT TEMPLE WITH A .380 WAD- CUTTER. HMM.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: IN THE SECOND CASE, THE IMPORTER -- ALSO UNDER INVESTIGATION FOR SMUGGLING. THIS TIME THERE WERE WITNESSES WHO SAW HIM JUMP OUT HIS APARTMENT WINDOW.. RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF A FAMILY DINNER

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AND NOW JERRY WATTS SLITS HIS OWN THROAT WITH A STRAIGHT RAZOR!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: JUMPING OUT A WINDOW... GUNSHOT TO THE HEAD.. ORTHODOX SUICIDE,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHAT CAN WE REALLY SAY?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: NO, NOT MUCH ROOM FOR SUS- PICION.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: NOT UNTIL THIS LAST CASE.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: SAY YOU'RE ACTUALLY HARDCORE ENOUGH TO GO BY CUTTING YOUR OWN THROAT. BUT YOUVE GOT A BODY- GUARD. WELL, SIMPLE WAY WOULD BE IN THEJOHN, WHEN THE KNOCK COMES ON THE DOOR, TEN MINUTES LATER, TUB'S FULL.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: BUT OUR MR. WATTS... FOR SOME REASON, HELIKED THINGS COMPLICATED FOR HE FELT THE NEED TO SNEAK UP BEHIND HIS BODYGUARD... AND TAKE THE GOOD TIME AND TROUBLE TO CUT HIS THROAT FIRST.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOUR COFFEE, SIR. NO SUGAR.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THANKS, CHARLIE,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHAT'S THAT?

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: HMPH.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: READ IT AND YOU'LL FIND IT THAT MUCH HARDER TO BELIEVE HE'D COMMIT SUICIDE.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: BEAT THE RAP ON A FRAUD COUNT THREE TIMES.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: SURVIVOR TYPE, YOU MIGHT SAY.
